title: Q37-I1 Analogy Audit & Transportability Contract
description: Repository-native, evidence-bound, deterministically validatable typed contract for analogy auditing and transportability gating. Every cross-domain mapping must declare source/target domain, mapped objects, relation preservation, invariants, mismatches, boundary conditions, scale/time/context differences, mechanism evidence, counteranalogy and negative-evidence search, scope of applicability and a claim ceiling. The system distinguishes SURFACE_SIMILARITY, METAPHOR_ONLY, STRUCTURAL_ANALOGY, MECHANISM_CANDIDATE and TRANSPORTABILITY_CANDIDATE, and blocks metaphor, local isomorphism, selective correspondence, unaudited structural maps or Q36 residual from being written as mechanism identity, causal proof or cross-domain universal law. Does NOT prove any two domains share a mechanism, does NOT prove real-world causal transportability, does NOT perform Q38 case retrieval, does NOT add L7 / truth layer, does NOT materialize F15/D1/D2.

q34_claims.description: Read-only Q34 claims referenced by analogy candidates (copied, never re-adjudicated by Q37). The validator checks each candidate's originating_q34_claim_ref resolves and that the claim permits the analogy purpose/ceiling.

claim_ceiling.description: Must not assert universal real-world mechanism or proven cross-domain causal law.

allows_analogy_purpose.description: Whether this claim permits being used as an analogy seed (search_seed) at all.

source_ref.description: Q33-gated source reference; must not be Q33-rejected.

q35_grants.description: Read-only Q35 authority grants referenced by analogy candidates/decisions (copied, never re-adjudicated by Q37).

q36_obs_snapshots.description: Read-only validated Q36-OBS observations/residuals referenced by analogy candidates (copied, never modified by Q37).

do_not_infer_cause.description: A Q36-OBS residual may trigger an analogy candidate or counteranalogy search, but must never be upgraded to a shared-cause proof by Q37.

q36_int_snapshots.description: Read-only Q36-INT mechanism hypotheses / intervention outcomes referenced by mechanism evidence (copied, never upgraded to universal mechanism by Q37).

do_not_upgrade_to_universal.description: A repo-local intervention outcome must not be promoted to a real-world universal mechanism by Q37.

q33_rights.description: Read-only Q33 source-rights records for any external material used as evidence (copied, never bypassed by Q37).

source_domain.description: Must be resolvable and not silently swapped for a different domain.

target_domain.description: Must be resolvable and not silently swapped for a different domain.

source_def.description: Definition of the source construct being mapped.

target_def.description: Definition of the target construct being mapped.

q35_authority_ref.description: Q35 authority that authorized proposing/auditing this candidate.

originating_q34_claim_ref.description: Q34 claim this analogy relies on; must be committed_current and permit the analogy purpose.

purpose.description: search_seed only means 'may enter Q38 as a restricted retrieval seed'; it does not assert the analogy is true or the mechanism holds.

candidate_type.description: MECHANISM_EQUIVALENCE_PROVEN and UNIVERSAL_LAW_PROVEN are deliberately NOT permitted as repository auto-outputs (validator fails closed).

provenance.description: Where this candidate came from; repo-internal replay must be labeled as such, not fabricated as external mechanism fact.

claim_ceiling.description: Must not assert universal real-world mechanism or proven cross-domain causal law. A local structural similarity may not be widened into a universal causal regularity.

exact_head.description: Binds the candidate to the exact repository head it was authored against.

relation_preservation.description: What relations are claimed preserved; must not exceed what the actual map supports.

cardinality_rationale.description: Legal justification for the declared cardinality; 1:n / n:1 / n:m must be explicitly declared, otherwise the validator fails closed.

known_mismatches.description: Non-correspondences / known mismatches. Must not be left blank to hide disagreement: a mapping with no declared mismatch AND no declared omitted variables AND no scale/time/context difference is 'suspiciously clean' and fails the negative-evidence semantic check (unless explicitly justified as INSUFFICIENTLY_SPECIFIED).

omitted_variables.description: Variables present in one domain but absent in the other; i.e. what the map leaves out.

hidden_premises.description: Assumptions imported from the source domain that are not stated in the target mapping (salvaged from lab hidden_premise_transfer concept).

scale_time_context_differences.description: Scale, temporal dynamics, lag and context differences between the domains; an undeclared scale mismatch or temporal/regime difference fails closed.

mapping_digest.description: Digest of the declared mapping content for tamper-evidence.

evidence_kind.description: Shared vocabulary, shared form, correlation or similar shape must NOT be treated as independent mechanism evidence (validator fails closed).

mechanism_evidence_ref.description: Required when status is BOUNDED_MECHANISM_EVIDENCE; must not circularly reference the analogy itself as its own evidence.

independent_evidence_ref.description: Reference to independent mechanism evidence outside the analogy under audit.

prohibited_promotions.description: Explicit list of claims this evidence must NOT be used to support (e.g. universal law, real-world causal transport).

transport_target.description: What is claimed transportable, and to what.

required_invariances.description: Invariances that must hold for transport; empty fails the transportability semantic check.

covariate_shift.description: Declared covariate shift; an unhandled shift fails closed.

concept_measurement_shift.description: Declared concept/measurement drift; an unhandled drift fails closed.

mechanism_moderator_shift.description: Declared mechanism/moderator shift; an unhandled shift fails closed.

scale_time_regime_shift.description: Declared scale/time/regime shift; an unhandled shift fails closed.

support_overlap.description: Overlap between source and target supports; empty/unsupported fails the transportability semantic check.

boundary_conditions.description: Explicit boundary conditions; empty fails the transportability semantic check.

falsification_conditions.description: Conditions under which transportability is falsified; empty fails the transportability semantic check.

counteranalogy_status.description: SUPPRESSED_DETECTED (counteranalogy/negative evidence removed) fails the counteranalogy semantic check.

q38_search_permission.description: ALLOWED_AS_RESTRICTED_SEED only means the analogy may enter Q38 as a restricted retrieval seed; it does NOT assert the analogy is true or the mechanism holds.

forbidden_inference.description: What must NOT be inferred (e.g. mechanism identity, universal law, real-world causal transport).

downgraded_claim_ceiling.description: Claim ceiling after audit; may be lower than the candidate's original ceiling.

reviewer_verifier.description: Agent/role that produced the audit decision (Hy3 reviewer in a fresh read-only context performs the independent review post-campaign; the builder records the decision object only).
